snippet.title: Quite a Ride Developer Presentation - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Alex from Goodwin Games provided an overview of Quite A Ride, the studio's atmospheric survival game where you ride your bike through a desolate forest, avoid anomalies and conserve your phone battery. It's coming soon to PC, with Goodwin Games primed to share more later this year.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166050/Quite_a_Ride/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
